description: On the bed in front of you, there’s a small white toy figure near the center and a small rectangular cardboard box to its right, with a pillow propped up behind. The left hand stays low and mostly still on the bed while the right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the toy as a right-hand object, lifts it up and slightly rightward, and then sets it down on top of the box to stack it before letting go.
